context.product: Native macOS control application for Logitech MX Master 4 over Bluetooth

stack.framework: SwiftUI with AppKit, IOKit HID, CoreGraphics and ServiceManagement
stack.buildSystem: Swift Package Manager with project shell scripts

namingPatterns: one primary responsibility per source file
domain values represented by named enums and structs
conventions.testingPattern: Executable checks built from pure MouseCore logic plus fake-dependent Spotlight regression checks; no automated physical mouse input or assigned actions

layers: device, scroll, action, ring and recovery services
MouseCore protocol and pure domain logic

modules.name: MouseCore
responsibilities: HID++ packet model and response matching

patterns: single outstanding request with strict response correlation
write then verify for hardware settings
pure core logic isolated from platform UI

externalBoundaries: Logitech MX Master 4 Bluetooth HID++ interface

constraints: Do not simulate mouse-button presses or wheel scrolling during automated verification
Do not execute assigned actions for verification
Do not persist serial numbers, Bluetooth addresses or activity history
Do not claim hardware behavior is verified before user device testing
Do not enable unsupported control flags or capabilities
Do not add network or telemetry behavior without an explicit architecture decision
